name: Knight
fantasy: A crusader in steel. Sword and shield, heavy blows, holy fire and a rallying cry.

directions.name: Crusader
directions.desc: Holy fire and the sword: Holy Slam and Holy Nova.

directions.name: Bulwark
directions.desc: Plate and shield: harder to hurt, harder to kill.

directions.name: Vanguard
directions.desc: First into the fight: Charge, Battle Cry and the sword combo.

skills.name: Holy Slam
skills.desc: Leap at the cursor and bring the sword down in a burst of white light: 160% weapon damage to everything around the blow, knocking them back and stunning them for 1 second.

skills.name: Holy Nova
skills.desc: A ring of holy fire bursts outward, burning enemies within 7 metres.

skills.name: Charge
skills.desc: Dash toward the cursor, smashing through enemies and knocking them back.

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.desc: Rally yourself: +40% damage and +50% defense for 12 seconds. Stuns nearby foes.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.desc: Spin with the sword out: everything within 3.2 metres is struck twice for 70% weapon damage. Every blow of yours leaves a Holy Brand on its foe (up to 5).

skills.name: Aegis
skills.desc: Raise a holy ward worth 35% of your life for 5 seconds and call everything within 5 metres onto you. When it breaks or ends, it bursts: everything within 5 metres takes all the damage it soaked.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.desc: Call a pillar of holy light down on the pointer: 120% weapon damage within 3 metres, +45% for every Holy Brand on each foe (the brands are spent), and holy fire burns them.

skills.name: Last Rites
skills.desc: Leap at the foe nearest the pointer and bring the sword down: 150% weapon damage, +2% for every 1% of life it is missing. A kill makes Last Rites ready again.

rites.name: Zeal
rites.text: +{dmg}% damage.

rites.name: Heavy Hand
rites.text: Holy Slam deals {dmg:cleave}% more damage.

rites.name: Radiance
rites.text: Holy Nova burns {dmg:nova}% hotter.

rites.name: Fervor
rites.text: +{ias}% attack speed.

rites.name: Sanctified Steel
rites.text: +{crit}% chance to land a critical hit.

rites.name: Purifying Fire
rites.text: Holy Nova costs {cost:nova}% less mana and recharges {cd:nova}% faster.

rites.name: Consecration
rites.text: Holy Nova heals you {nova_heal}% of your life for every enemy it burns (up to 5).

rites.name: Toughness
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense.

rites.name: Vigor
rites.text: +{life_pct}% maximum life.

rites.name: Shield Wall
rites.text: +{block}% chance to block with a shield.

rites.name: Resolve
rites.text: +{res}% to all resistances.

rites.name: Iron Guard
rites.text: Block stops {block_dr}% more damage from the front.

rites.name: Second Wind
rites.text: +{regen} life regenerated per second.

rites.name: Unbreakable
rites.text: Battle Cry heals {cry_heal}% of your life and lasts {buff_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Momentum
rites.text: +{frw}% run speed.

rites.name: Might
rites.text: +{str} strength.

rites.name: Battering Ram
rites.text: Charge hits {dmg:charge}% harder and recharges {cd:charge}% faster.

rites.name: Swordplay
rites.text: Your weapon attack deals {dmg:attack}% more damage.

rites.name: Commander
rites.text: Battle Cry's damage bonus is {buff_pow}% higher.

rites.name: Rally
rites.text: Battle Cry recharges {cd:cry}% faster.

rites.name: Relentless
rites.text: Every enemy Charge smashes through takes {charge_cdr} second off your other cooldowns.

rites.name: Wrath of Heaven
rites.text: Judgment calls {judgment_more} more pillars round the first, each {dmg:k_judgment}% stronger.

rites.name: Bastion
rites.text: Aegis's ward is {aegis_pct}% of your life stronger and comes back {cd:k_aegis}% sooner; its burst is twice as hard.

rites.name: Unending Spin
rites.text: Blade Storm spins {whirl_more} more time and hits {dmg:k_whirl}% harder.

rites.name: No Quarter
rites.text: A Last Rites kill also gives you +30% damage and +20% run speed for 4 seconds.

rites.name: Searing Brands
rites.text: Holy Brands stack {brand_max} higher and each one burns its foe a little.

rites.name: Zealot
rites.text: Your sword sets foes alight with holy fire ({pct}% of the blow a second).

rites.name: Iron Hide
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense and a ward of {ward_bonus}% of your life that refills out of combat.

rites.name: Cleaving Blows
rites.text: Your sword's blows cleave into {bounces} more foes beside the one struck ({pct}%).

rites.name: Sacred Flame
rites.text: Critical hits set foes alight with holy fire ({pct}% of the hit a second).

rites.name: Martyr's Resolve
rites.text: Monsters that strike you take {pct}% of the blow back in holy fire.

rites.name: Onslaught
rites.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.
